subject: The 3-minute routine that changes everything
preview_text: Dog owners share a quick habit that makes PupShape 10x more effective. Try it today.
body_paragraphs: Remember that first week with PupShape when you logged every meal, tracked every walk, and felt like a superhero for your dog? I do too. Then life got messy, and that feeling faded. But here's the thing—there's a 3-minute routine our top users swear by that makes this app 10x more effective, and it's simpler than you think.

The secret isn't more time or willpower; it's a tiny habit anchored to something you already do. Like brushing your teeth or making coffee. Just three minutes: open the app, log your dog's morning meal, and plan one walk. That's it. It triggers the habit loop—cue, routine, reward—and suddenly consistency becomes automatic. Our data shows users who do this for 10 days straight see their dogs lose weight 2x faster, and 110+ dogs are already on healthier paths.

This routine works because it's tied to the 'Log a Meal' feature. Once you start, you'll notice the calorie calculator helps you spot hidden treats, and the progress tracker gives you a weekly pat on the back. You're not just using an app; you're building an identity as the dog parent who has it figured out.

Here's your move: tomorrow morning, before you do anything else, open PupShape and log your dog's breakfast. Set a timer for 3 minutes. That's it. One small step that changes everything. P.S. The guilt of seeing your dog struggle to play? This routine erases it. You'll feel that relief every single day.
